{{Quote|The Twi'lek vibroblade master from Ord Mantell? Gone. The Chiss droid builder fond of explosives? Gone. That just leaves your protege to remove.|Tarro Blood|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
A [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] '''bounty hunter''' from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] who was considered to be a master with a [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]] attempted to enter the [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunt]] in [[3643 BBY]], but [[Tarro Blood]] had his crew sabotage the Twi'lek, successfully eliminating the vibroblade master as Blood's competition.
